[unplugin] Declare externalPackages option and fix dead docs link (#1863)

core.js reads externalPackages and passes it to package discovery as
explicitPackages, and unplugin.mdx documents it, but it was never declared
on UserOptions, and it isn't part of babel-plugin's StyleXOptions either,
so passing it from TypeScript was a type error.

The same docs page linked to ./babel-plugin.mdx, the only relative link
left in the docs and the only one with an .mdx suffix. Pointed it at
/docs/api/configuration/babel-plugin like every other internal link.

Fixes #1563
